s00A635.name: Level start setup, Mario Start! graphics
summary: $00A635: level start reset. Cancels POW/star timers (forcing normal music), clears Mario and level state, then positions Mario for the
level entrance type [$192A] (start in the air, from a pipe, water level, keyhole, Yoshi Wings bonus). Several parts are guesses.
$00A796: initializes layer 2 vertical scroll offset [$1417] from [$1414], [$1C], [$20], and [$142A] = $0080.
$00A7C2: DMAs the buffer at $7F:977B to VRAM $6000, $6100, $64A0 and $65A0 ($C0 bytes each) for the Mario Start! graphics.
$00A82D: builds those tiles: decompresses GFX file $0F, converts 24 tiles from 3bpp to 4bpp into $7F:977B (+$30 offset if [$1425]),
also converts 12 tiles of file 0 into $0BF6, sets [$143A] and [$1935] so NMI DMAs them.

SPRITEGFXLIST.name: Table: sprite GFX file lists
summary: 4 GFX file numbers per entry, indexed by [$192B] * 4. The first file goes to VRAM $6000, the last to $7800.

OBJECTGFXLIST.name: Table: tileset GFX lists, raw GFX upload
summary: 4 GFX file numbers per tileset, indexed by [$1931] * 4. The first file goes to VRAM $0000, the last to $1800.
$00A993: uploads GFX files $28-$2B uncompressed (1024 words each) to VRAM $4000 and file 0 to $6000 via UploadGFXFile.

s00A9D2.name: Table: VRAM slot addresses for GFX upload
summary: $A9D2: sprite slots, $A9D6: FG/BG slots. High byte of the VRAM word address, one per slot.

UploadSpriteGFX.name: Upload sprite and tileset GFX to VRAM
summary: Loads the 4 sprite GFX files for list [$192B] into VRAM $6000-$7FFF, then the 4 FG/BG files for tileset [$1931] into $0000-$1FFF.
[$0101]-[$0104] and [$0105]-[$0108] remember the file in each slot, so a slot whose file is unchanged is not re-uploaded.
Parameters: [$192B]: sprite GFX list. [$1931]: tileset.

GFXTransferLoop.name: Sprite GFX: upload loop over 4 slots
summary: Slot 3 down to 0: set the VRAM address from DATA_00A9D2 and upload the file unless it is already loaded.

PrepLoadFGBG.name: FG/BG GFX: pick files and upload
summary: Tileset >= $FE goes to SetallFGBG80. Otherwise copies the 4 files of OBJECTGFXLIST for the tileset to [$04]-[$07] and uploads each changed slot.

SetallFGBG80.name: Tileset $FE/$FF: Mode 7 upload, empty slots
summary: Tileset $FF uploads the Mode 7 tile graphics (CODE_00AB42). Both then mark all FG/BG slots as empty ($80).

UploadGFXFile.name: Decompress GFX file and start upload
summary: Decompresses file Y into the $7E:AD00 buffer. For file 1, if the Special World is completed ([$1EEB] bit 7) file $31 replaces it.
Then picks the 3bpp to 4bpp conversion mode (see below). Parameters: Y = GFX file number; VRAM address already set.

SkipSpecial.name: Choose 3bpp conversion mode
summary: File $1E, or file 8 in tilesets >= $11, goes to the full conversion; every other file continues at $00AA99.

JumpTo_____.name: Convert 3bpp GFX to 4bpp, upload to VRAM
summary: Converts 128 tiles of 24 bytes (3bpp) to 4bpp while writing them to VRAM. Plane 3 is the mask [$0A] AND (plane 0 | 1 | 2) of each row.
Files other than 1 and $17: plane 3 empty. Files 1 and $17: plane 3 filled only for tiles $6E-$6F and $7E-$7F.

FilterSomeRAM.name: Full 3bpp to 4bpp conversion setup
summary: Sets mask [$0A] = $FF00 (plane 3 = OR of planes 0-2) for all 128 tiles and falls into the loop.

Upload????ToVRAM.name: 3bpp to 4bpp: tile loop start
summary: Starts with a compare and branch that do nothing.

AddressWrite1.name: 3bpp to 4bpp: planes 0-1 of a tile
summary: Writes 8 rows of plane 0/1 words to VRAM and keeps each row's plane 0 | plane 1 in [$1BB2+X].

AddressWrite2.name: 3bpp to 4bpp: planes 2-3; Mode 7 upload
summary: Writes the plane 2/3 words of the tile's 8 rows, then loops to the next tile.
$00AB42: uploads GFX file $27 as Mode 7 tile graphics. The file is packed 3 bits per pixel; each pixel is written to the VRAM high byte
($2119, Mode 7 tile data lives there), 8192 pixels, then another $2000 high bytes are cleared. $00ABC4 extracts 3 bits into [$04].

s00ABDF.name: Table: 16-bit offsets (step $38)
summary: Used at CODE_00AD44.

LoadPalette.name: Load level palettes into buffer
summary: Fills the palette buffer at $0703 (backdrop at $0701) for the current level: fixed colors, then the palette sets chosen by [$192D] (FG), [$192E] (sprite),
[$1930] (BG) and the backdrop color [$192F]. Uses LoadColors ($00 = source, $04 = buffer offset, $06 = colors-1, $08 = palettes-1).

LoadCol8Pal.name: Set one color in 8 palettes
summary: Writes [$04] to the buffer at $0703+X, then every $20 bytes. Parameters: X = buffer offset, [$04] = color.
